# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/pin

Pin an issue to the repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-376`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | int64 | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Max pin limit reached
- **403** — User lacks write permission
- **404** — Issue not found
- **500** — Database error

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.PinIssue | controller | Get issue by index; Load repo; Call issues_model.PinIssue |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | issues_model.GetIssueByIndex | repository | SELECT issue WHERE repo_id AND `index` |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | issues_model.PinIssue | service | Count existing pins; Check max pin limit; Get max pin_order; INSERT issue_pin; Create pin comment |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Maximum pin limit check - cannot pin more issues than setting.Repository.Issue.MaxPinned (default 3) | validation | pinnedIssuesNum >= setting.Repository.Issue.MaxPinned |
| Pin order is assigned as max existing order + 1 when pinning | business_logic | Always when pinning |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Issue index not found in repo | 404 | notFound | False |
| Max pin count reached | 400 | error message | False |
| DB failure | 500 | internal error | True |

### Error Paths

- **Issue not found** → repo.PinIssue → 404
- **Max pin reached** → repo.PinIssue → 400
- **DB error** → repo.PinIssue → 500
